nodes.description: IERC20 public umbToken: the ERC20 token distributed by the vesting contract
uint256 public totalVestingAmount: cumulative sum of all rewards promised
uint256 public paidSoFar: total amount already claimed by all participants
mapping(address => Reward) public rewards: per-participant vesting schedule (total, duration, paid, startTime)
address private _owner: owner of the contract inherited from Ownable
function balanceOf(address) public view returns (uint256): computes vested claimable amount using block.timestamp
function claim() external: lets msg.sender claim their vested tokens
function claimFor(address[] calldata) external: loops over participants and claims on their behalf
internal function _claim(address): updates paid accounting and performs the external umbToken.transfer
function addRewards(address[],uint256[],uint256[],uint256[]) external onlyOwner: sets up vesting schedules and totalVestingAmount
function transferOwnership(address) public onlyOwner: changes contract owner
function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner: sets owner to address(0)
function owner() public view: returns _owner and is used by the onlyOwner modifier
LinearVesting constructor(address _owner, address _token): sets the token and transfers ownership
msg.sender: caller controlled address used by claim()/_msgSender()
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time used for vesting calculations
external call umbToken.transfer(_participant, balance) made before state is fully settled (reentrancy surface)
unchecked accumulation rewards[_participant].paid += balance and paidSoFar += balance (bypasses SafeMath)
vesting amount is derived directly from block.timestamp comparisons and subtraction/multiplication/division
address _address parameter of balanceOf
Reward memory reward: local copy of the reward struct read from rewards mapping
address[] calldata _participants parameter of claimFor
address _participant parameter of internal _claim
uint256 balance: claimable amount computed by balanceOf and paid out by transfer
address[] calldata _participants parameter of addRewards
uint256[] calldata _rewards parameter of addRewards
uint256[] calldata _durations parameter of addRewards
uint256[] calldata _startTimes parameter of addRewards
uint256 sum: running total of vested amounts, written back into totalVestingAmount
uint256 total: previous reward total for a participant, used to adjust sum
uint256 i: loop index over the participant arrays in addRewards
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
address _owner constructor parameter
address _token constructor parameter assigned to umbToken
uint i: loop index over _participants in claimFor

edges.reason: claim() forwards execution to internal _claim which performs the external token transfer
claimFor loops and calls _claim repeatedly, each iteration performing an external transfer
msg.sender is passed as the claimant into claim(), driving the payout path
msg.sender becomes the _participant whose reward is read and paid inside _claim
block.timestamp controls the vesting branch selection inside balanceOf
block.timestamp is the direct input to the unsafe timestamp-dependent arithmetic
_claim invokes the external umbToken.transfer transfer before completing accounting
the external token transfer can re-enter _claim/claim before paidSoFar and rewards are consistent
_claim performs unchecked += on rewards[_participant].paid and paidSoFar without SafeMath
_claim reads and updates the rewards mapping for the participant
_claim increments the paidSoFar state variable
_claim reads umbToken to execute the ERC20 transfer
addRewards writes new Reward structs into the rewards mapping
addRewards recomputes and stores totalVestingAmount from sum
addRewards calls balanceOf to ensure a reward is not reduced below what is already vested
balanceOf reads the Reward struct of the queried address from the rewards mapping
transferOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner state variable
renounceOwnership clears the privileged _owner state variable
owner() returns the _owner state variable
onlyOwner modifier on addRewards enforces owner() == _msgSender()
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership enforces owner() == _msgSender()
onlyOwner modifier on renounceOwnership enforces owner() == _msgSender()
constructor assigns the token address to the umbToken state variable
constructor calls transferOwnership via the Owned base to hand ownership to _owner
constructor indirectly sets _owner through transferOwnership
_address parameter indexes the rewards mapping inside balanceOf
local Reward copy is used for the timestamp and payout computations in balanceOf
_participants array supplies the addresses iterated in claimFor
_participant parameter selects the reward entry and transfer recipient in _claim
local balance is the amount transferred out and added to paid accounting in _claim
local balance flows into the unchecked += updates of paid and paidSoFar
_participants array provides the recipients configured in addRewards
_rewards array provides the vesting totals used in addRewards
_durations array provides the vesting durations validated in addRewards
_startTimes array provides the vesting start times validated in addRewards
local sum accumulates the new totalVestingAmount inside addRewards
local total holds the previous reward total used to adjust sum
loop index i drives iteration over the participant arrays in addRewards
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner value
constructor _owner argument is forwarded to transferOwnership
constructor _token argument is validated and stored in umbToken
loop index i drives iteration over _participants in claimFor
